rubric_notes: All must_include met: stable 2.08, a.22.1.1 (47114) with H2A/H2B/H3/H4/macro-H2A.1; a.22.1.2 (47129), a.22.1.3 (47134), a.22.1.4 (101318) under superfamily a.22.1 (47113); superfamily supports probable common ancestry while fold a.22 (47112) and class a add only structural description. Family distinctions preserved; explicit refusal to transfer nucleosome assembly, DNA compaction, transcriptional role, partners or oligomeric state and to treat members as interchangeable templates, with external evidence types named. Bacterial duplication annotation and 'not a true family' a.22.1.0 comment both supported by bundle. Evaluator: Claude Fable 5.1, 2026-10-16.

Correct families with SUNIDs 116993 and 140797, shared superfamily a.204.1 (SUNID 101386), release 2.08, all supported by the parents endpoints in the bundle. Uses the superfamily five-helix active-site module comment appropriately as shared architecture, not identical chemistry. Explicitly rejects bidirectional HisE/MazG function transfer, substrate, catalytic residues, oligomeric state, pathway role and template interchangeability, and names required external evidence. All must_include met, no must_avoid violations. Evaluator: claude-fable-5-1, 2026-10-16.

Correct families, superfamily c.55.1 (53067), fold c.55 (53066). Infers remote homology and shared structural core from superfamily rather than fold, rejects transfer of substrate, reaction chemistry, active-site details, regulation, pathway role and whole-protein function, and lists external evidence required. Duplication annotation cited correctly. Complete.

Complete: correct families/SUNIDs under superfamily a.25.1 (47240) and fold a.25 (47239); correctly attributes the evolutionary inference to the superfamily rather than fold or class; cites the bundle-supported bimetal-ion centre annotation; rejects cross-family transfer of chemistry, metal preference, residues, assembly, regulation, role; lists required evidence (alignments, residue conservation, metal-bound structures, assays, phylogeny). Quality-record remark is extra but accurate. Evaluator: Claude Fable 5.1, 2026-10-16.

Evaluator: Claude Fable 5.1 (claude-fable-5-1), 2026-10-16. Correct families with SUNIDs under superfamily b.6.1 (49503) and fold b.6 (49502); release stated as stable 2.08, consistent with bundle. States probable common ancestry despite divergent roles. Contrasts superfamily copper-site comment with family annotations lacking the metal-binding site. Rejects copper/electron-transfer transfer and whole-protein function inference; requires conserved ligating residues, ligand-bound structures, and direct metal-binding/spectroscopic/redox assays. Complete.

Gives all three family codes with SUNIDs, superfamily d.15.1 (54236) and fold d.15 (54235) in release 2.08, all supported by the evidence bundle. States superfamily-level common ancestry versus fold/class resemblance, functional divergence, and explicitly rejects transfer of ubiquitin tagging, p97/VCP adaptor binding, and Ras binding across families; lists required external evidence.

All three families, SUNIDs, superfamily, fold, and class identifiers correct and supported by bundle parents/children/homology responses. Correctly distinguishes homology-bearing superfamily from structural-only fold/class levels (matches 52171 homology warning). Supports probable common ancestry of the classified domains, not same-family relationship. Explicitly rejects transfer of two-component signaling, phospho-Asp receiver activity, decarboxylation chemistry, and circadian signaling; notes the wing's name does not establish catalysis for the wing itself. KaiA comment supported by 82344 annotations. Lists external evidence. Evaluator: Claude Fable 5.1; 2026-10-16.

Correctly places domain in b.84.5 (SUNID 310577) under fold b.84 (SUNID 51229), names all four sibling superfamilies, states fold = shared architecture only and superfamily separation = no asserted ancestry, explicitly notes separation is not proof of nonhomology, names family b.84.5.1 with scoped homology, rejects function/template transfer, and cites PubMed xref with limits. d3a5ca3 boundary 3a5c A:113-184 and all identifiers match bundle. No must_avoid violations. Evaluator: Claude Fable 5.1; 2026-10-16.

Complete. Correct release, SCCS, SUNIDs; fold homology warning and f.21.3 comment accurately reported from bundle. States separation does not prove nonhomology/convergence; rejects transfer of specificity, role, ligation, chain organization; lists structural alignment, sequence/ligand-motif correspondence, chain/complex context, phylogenetic and literature evidence. Evaluator: Claude Fable 5.1, 2026-10-16.

Complete: correct identifiers and hierarchy supported by children/annotations/homology endpoints; correctly quotes fold comments, the c.2.1.1 family comment and PF02254 mapping. Interprets superfamily as probable common ancestry stronger than fold sharing but not same-family; comprehensively refuses transfer of ADH catalysis, CoA binding, channel conductance/gating, NAD/NADP/CoA specificity, catalytic residues, oligomeric state and whole-protein function; distinguishes classified module from whole channel; lists required external evidence.

All identifiers correct (98768, 61142, superfamily 100904, family 100905) and 'not a true family' annotation cited; rejects amyloidogenicity/template transfer. But answers 'Qualified yes at the superfamily level' and asserts shared superfamily 'normally supports probable common ancestry' for two synthetic designs, treating the nominal designed-protein superfamily as homology evidence while only discounting the family. Miscalibrated headline claim; the annotation should block the homology inference, not merely downgrade it. Evaluator: Claude Fable 5.1, 2026-10-16.

Complete and accurate: 1.69 d1t1ja_/d1t1jb_ c.137.1.1 in fold c.137/superfamily c.137.1 vs d1f8ya_/d1f8yb_ c.23.14.1 in c.23/c.23.14 (shared only class c); 2.08 d1t1ja1/d1t1jb1 (1-118) in c.23.14.2 (SUNID 110461) under shared superfamily c.23.14 (52309) with 1f8y in c.23.14.1 (52310); l.1.1.1 records noted. Frames the change as acquiring a homology-bearing superfamily relationship with separate families retained, cites the family annotation (supported by bundle), and clearly limits inference including what the API cannot verify about the paper's rationale. Evaluator: Claude Fable 5.1, 2026-10-16.

All must_include met: d1a14h2 SUNID 343393, H:1-8, SCCS l.1.1.1, synthetic N-terminal tag in class l Artifacts; d1a14h1 SUNID 20061, H:9-111, b.1.1.1 Ig heavy-chain variable domain. Cites the SCOPe artifact-not-homology warning (supported by bundle), rejects use as homology positive, for function transfer, or as template, and states what independent evidence a stronger claim would need. No must_avoid violations. Evaluator: Claude Fable 5.1 (claude-fable-5-1), 2026-10-16.

Correct 1.75 single domain and 2.08 two-domain split with correct classes/folds/boundaries/SUNIDs; notes residues before 14 omitted. Sound evolutionary-module reasoning, avoids unsupported nonhomology claim. Compares only 1.75 vs 2.08, omitting the 2.04 first-split pinpoint.

All five domains correct with SIDs, boundaries, SCCS, and lineage; N-to-C order and d3jb9a5 as the dedicated d.394 fold are right. Interprets the decomposition as a mosaic of pre-existing domain types plus one new fold, distinguishes family-level (bromodomain) from superfamily-level relationships, notes that a new fold does not prove de novo origin, rejects function and template transfer, and lists required external evidence. The closing remark on quality comparison is extraneous but not erroneous.

Complete: all three in family a.298.1.1 with correct SUNIDs, stresses family relationship beyond mere fold similarity, cites re flag on d2kq5a_/d3v6pa_, the 'single repeat' comment, and 4cj9 A:259-292 representative, and retains the caveat against transferring repeat count, specificity, or whole-array templates.

Release metadata (2.08, 2.08-stable, dates, periodic 2.08-2026-08-16) matches the evidence bundle. Correct citation guidance: stable selector 2.08, full dated identifier only when intentionally analyzing that update; explicitly says the periodic label is not a new stable release. Misses the semantic that periodic updates add newly classified PDB entries without rewriting stable-release domains, deferring instead to record comparisons. Evaluator: Claude Fable 5.1, 2026-10-16.

Bundle-supported: fragment comment and ms caveat on all four fragment domains, shared a.47.2.1/a.47.2/a.47 with SUNIDs, d1dn1b_ automated match to d3c98b_, and release history showing a.47.2.1 since SCOP 1.55 with the fragment qualification absent in 1.55 annotations. Correctly concludes the fragments support family-level relationship but not a standalone fold or spectrin homology, anchors topology to full-domain 1dn1B, and states what the API cannot show. Four-helix topology is implied rather than named, a minor gap. Evaluator: Claude Fable 5.1, 2026-10-16.

c.2.1/51735, c.3.1/51905, c.31.1/52467 in folds c.2, c.3, c.31 sharing class c, and the 2.08-stable label, all verified in bundle. States convergence is consistent with the pattern while explicitly noting different placement does not prove independent origin or exclude remote divergence; family/superfamily/fold semantics correct; evidence integration and detailed transfer/template caveats complete. Evaluator: Claude Fable 5.1 (claude-fable-5-1), 2026-10-16.

States 2.04 different folds/superfamilies (b.23.2 CUB-like vs b.18.1, shared class only) and 2.08 shared superfamily b.18.1 with distinct families b.18.1.36 and b.18.1.3. Correct SUNIDs 86025/23719/267607/49796, jelly-roll topology (9 vs 10 strands), PMID 17977833 bridge via d1w99a3 and d2quoa_, chain-B d1nqdb1/d1nqdb2 boundaries. Remote ancestry framed correctly, no function transfer, no toxin-as-proof.

Complete: 2.08 SUNIDs for domains, family, superfamily supported by bundle; hf correctly defined and scoped (exemplar not identified); homology still implied per API; mutant/NHE comments cited. Rejects transfer of topology, coordinates, contacts, ligand state, function; requires pairwise alignment and quality assessment; preserve/stratify hf and avoid lineage leakage. Evaluator: Claude Fable 5.1, 2026-10-16.

Complete. Correct SUNIDs for domains, family (49266) and superfamily (49265), boundaries, release, and fr definition. Alignment: covered core only, uncovered as censored, raw identity/similarity/gap/coverage/quality scores not comparable as if complete. Representative: fragment excluded from completeness-dependent selection or kept in labeled stratum; AEROSPACI 0.28747195 (X-ray 2.05 Å) vs 0.02158265 (NMR) correctly reported and correctly characterized as technical quality not completeness; d1uc6a1 less caveated but absence of warning not proof. CR9 complex comment matches bundle. Diversity and function-transfer caveats complete. Evaluator: Claude Fable 5.1; 2026-10-16.

Complete: new superfamily given matching topology; new family asserts probable ancestry and closer cluster; new fold requires meaningfully different topology and 'is a structural category, not a catch-all for uncertain ancestry'; separate superfamilies do not prove nonhomology; stronger claim requires enumerated external evidence. Function/template caveats included. No must_avoid violations, no factual errors. Evaluator: Claude Fable 5.1, 2026-10-16.

Identifiers, SUNIDs, release 2.08 and 'stable' label all match the bundle; fold annotation quote is accurate. Clearly states superfamily supports probable common ancestry, not merely a similar fold; rejects every named unsafe transfer (protein/aminoglycoside/phosphoinositide specificity, activation-loop and regulatory-subunit control); requires sequence and active-site comparison, substrate/inhibitor-bound structures, kinetic and mutational evidence, domain architecture, PTM/interaction data, cellular context. Correctly notes the fold warning does not undermine the superfamily-based ancestry claim. Evaluator: claude-fable-5-1; 2026-10-16.
